messages:
isabella: Quick intake from sales — large EU fintech wants Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1. They expect steady gen load ~400 RPS (avg ~120 tokens/request) with daily bursts up to 1200 RPS lasting 10-15m at market open. Need quote + SLA. They plan to use instruction-tuned Llama2-70B variant. Can we size and confirm earliest availability? cc @raj @hao :eyes:
raj: thx. couple quick Qs — is 400 RPS sustained 24/7 or business-hours peak baseline? and what's acceptable p95 latency?
isabella: baseline is business-hours 09:00–17:00 CET, so sustained ~400 during that window. p95 target is <= 500ms for gen requests. Customer is sensitive to stalls during bursts.
hao: model family + seq len matter. for instr-tuned 70B, at 120 tokens avg, rough GPU footprint = ~1.2x of base 70B because of kv usage. Need token/sec calc: 400 RPS * 120 tokens = 48k tokens/sec sustained. burst 1200 -> 144k tokens/sec.
ellie: ops note — we should propose a plan with a warm pool + autoscale and an upper burst buffer. recommend warm pool to handle baseline with headroom, autoscale to add instances for sustained growth, and a short-lived burst pool for market opens.
oliver: support asks — what are rollback/fallback options if Dedicated can't handle burst? can we route overflow to hosted API or lower-capacity model?
hao: fallback options: 1) route to a smaller quantized 30B variant (degraceful but fast), 2) route to hosted Redwood pool (ack latency increase/cost), 3) implement token-throttling with early stop. Need product decision on acceptable fallback.
raj: we'll need launch criteria before committing to quote: (a) performance validation at 400 RPS sustained for 4h, (b) burst test to 1200 RPS for 15m without error rate >0.1%, (c) end-to-end p95 <=500ms, (d) monitoring + alerting in Console + runbook. agree?
isabella: yes, sales needs those. also they asked about lead time — what's realistic?
hao: depends on capacity availability. If we provision new GPU pool in eu-west-1, timeline ~3–4 weeks (procure nodes + config + canary). If they accept smaller model fallback for bursts, we can do soft-launch in 1–2 weeks by reserving existing spare capacity.
ellie: suggested autoscale config snippet for sizing discussion:
```
{
  "pool": "dedicated-eu-fintech-1",
  "min_instances": 12,   // warm pool for baseline
  "scale_policy": {
    "scale_out_threshold_rps": 450,
    "scale_step": 4,
    "cooldown_sec": 60
  },
  "burst_pool": {
    "max_instances": 40,
    "prewarmed": 8,
    "burst_window_sec": 900
  }
}
```
hao: rough calc using our perf numbers: 1 instance (A100-like) can handle ~35 RPS at 70B/120t with target latency. So baseline 400 -> ~12 instances (matches min_instances). Burst 1200 -> ~34 instances -> recommend max_instances ~40 to have buffer.
oliver: pricing ask from sales — can we provide two options: (A) reserved pool + SLA (committed monthly), (B) hybrid reserved baseline + pay-for-burst on hosted API. Sales needs per-hour committed pricing and burst cost multiplier.
raj: product decision required on supported burst policies for Dedicated: Allow burst to hosted automatically? or require explicit cross-account routing agreement? also need to decide if we offer managed warm-pool prewarm as part of SLA or as add-on.
isabella: customer prefers guaranteed behavior during open — they'd like hard burst guarantee. they may accept higher price for that.
hao: hard guarantee implies dedicated spare capacity reserved and included in commit-> higher cost. if they want hard 1200 RPS guarantee, reserve ~40 instances. prep for SLA wording: availability, latency SLO, compensated downtime.
ellie: operational checklist for launch: - perf runbook - Canary rollout traffic split (5% -> 25% -> 100%) - alerting thresholds (error rate, queue length, cold starts) - billing config for reserved vs burst - access for customer monitoring (read-only)
raj: prioritization: this is a high-value enterprise ask but depends on contract. Recommend we move to a short PRD: scope = baseline + burst guarantee option; success metrics = pass launch criteria above; effort = eng runtime + infra + sales/legal. Target: PRD and estimate in 1 week.
isabella: I'll collect contract details and ask customer if they'd accept hybrid first. will loop back with acceptance on fallback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deployment quota check — eu-west-1 has 22 spare A100-equivalent slots in our pool right now.
hao: good to know. if we use spare capacity we can do soft-launch next week for a hybrid setup. for hard guarantee we'll need procurement for ~18 additional units.
raj: I'll kick off a PRD doc and tag relevant squads. action items: isabella -> confirm fallback choice by EOD Tue; hao -> perf baseline run estimate by Thu; ellie -> draft runbook template.
isabella: noted — will update.
